goal: Find untested behaviour, weak assertions and risky code paths across a large codebase using Recursive Languag…
use: Find untested behaviour, weak assertions and risky code paths across a large codebase using Recursive Language Model (RLM) decomposition, with ranked gaps and concrete test cases to add. Use when asked about test coverage, test quality or where tests are missing, on code too large to read in one pass.

steps.note: Coverage first. If the project has a coverage tool configured (for example `pytest --cov`, `jest --coverage`, `go test -cover`), run it and keep the report.
Inspect. Run `python3 <skill>/scripts/rlm_corpus.py scan <repo> --include 'src/*'` (adjust the glob to the source folder).
Map. For each source chunk, run a fresh sub-task (a subagent if you can start one) that sees the chunk and the "Chunk task" below.
Verify. For each high-risk gap, search the test folder for the function name (`grep -rn "name" <repo>/tests`) to confirm no test exercises it.

protocol.title: Coverage first
protocol.text: If the project has a coverage tool configured (for example `pytest --cov`, `jest --coverage`, `go test -cover`), run it and keep the report. Use it to confirm each gap before you report it. Do not install tools without asking.

protocol.title: Inspect
protocol.text: Run `python3 <skill>/scripts/rlm_corpus.py scan <repo> --include 'src/*'` (adjust the glob to the source folder). Note the layout. Agree the scope with the user if the code base is very large.

protocol.title: Partition
protocol.text: Run `WORK=$(mktemp -d)`, then `python3 <skill>/scripts/rlm_corpus.py chunk <repo> "$WORK/chunks" --include 'src/*'`. Chunks are limited to 800 lines and 100,000 characters each. The test folder is not chunked: the sub-tasks see only source code, so tests are checked by searching them in step 6.

protocol.title: Map
protocol.text: For each source chunk, run a fresh sub-task (a subagent if you can start one) that sees the chunk and the "Chunk task" below. If you cannot start sub-tasks, run `python3 <skill>/scripts/rlm_corpus.py pending "$WORK/chunks" "$WORK/out"` and process the first listed chunk, then run `pending` again until nothing is pending.

protocol.title: Reduce
protocol.text: Run `python3 <skill>/scripts/rlm_corpus.py merge "$WORK/out" --out "$WORK/merged.json"`. Re-run any `failed_outputs`. A missing output is an unanalysed chunk, not "fully tested".

protocol.title: Verify
protocol.text: For each high-risk gap, search the test folder for the function name (`grep -rn "name" <repo>/tests`) to confirm no test exercises it.

protocol.title: Report
protocol.text: Write the report in the format below.

protocol.title: Clean up
protocol.text: Delete `$WORK` after the report is delivered.
